Title and Summary

Research & Development Co-Op (WashU), Spring 2027 – St. Louis, MO, US

What team will I join?
Mastercard Foundry is a global innovation group exploring emerging technologies and consumer trends that shape the future of payments and commerce. Within Foundry, the global Research and Development team applies advanced research to build scalable products for Mastercard.
Foundry R&D brings together experts across engineering, science, design, data, research, and program management, with focus areas including quantum computing, extended reality, privacy-enhancing technologies, generative AI, and machine learning. The team develops future-focused concepts that inspire customers and strengthen innovation across Mastercard.

We are seeking talented software engineers and data scientists to help build advanced technologies transforming payments. This co-op offers hands-on experience developing business skills while contributing to Mastercard’s goals and innovation priorities.

Location: Mastercard St. Louis Tech Hub located in O’Fallon, MO. Must be able to be in office 3+ days a week
Duration: January 2027 to May 2027, 40 hours per week
Hourly Rate: $34/hr

What will I do?
As a Research & Development Co-op, you will:
- Be a member of a high-performing team of software engineers, architects, data scientists, and product innovators who are shaping the future of payments and commerce.
- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions using modern engineering practices, tools, and technologies.
- Contribute proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and next-generation products focused on emerging technologies such as AI, cloud computing, data platforms, and other innovation initiatives within R&D.
- Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from ideation and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and operational support.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product, Experience Design, and Research to solve complex business and technology challenges.
- Apply software engineering best practices, including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and performance optimization.
- Explore and evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and tools to help drive innovation and accelerate product development.
- Gain hands-on experience building scalable, resilient applications while working alongside experienced engineers and technical leaders in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
- Present technical findings, demos, and project outcomes to engineering and business stakeholders.
- Develop practical experience in research, experimentation, and product incubation while contributing to real-world solutions used across Mastercard.

- Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree or accelerated master's program at WashU (Washington University in St. Louis) majoring in engineering, data science, or a related field with a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
- Exposure to algorithms, data structures, AI/Agentic AI, and core computer science concepts
- Exposure automated tests to verify code correctness and expected behavior.
- Knowledge of source control management (e.g., git), deployment, and task management tools.
- Strong analytical and excellent problem-solving skills and familiarity with the role of debugging tools and information which diagnose issues such as stack traces, memory profiling, code tracing, etc.

Project Overview
The Global E-commerce ecosystem has accumulated massive heterogeneous data, including user behavior, product images and text, multimedia content, sales data, and logistics time series. However, traditional models still face significant limitations in long-term forecasting, cross-modal understanding, and complex decision-making.
This project aims to build a foundational large model tailored for Global E-commerce scenarios. It will unify key elements such as users, products, content, logistics, and inventory into a single modeling framework. On top of this, a modular, pluggable Agent framework will be designed to integrate capabilities such as task planning, tool usage, multi-turn interaction, and environmental awareness. This enables end-to-end intelligent decision-making across workflows like demand forecasting, traffic allocation, and personalized recommendation.

1. Heterogeneous Data Fusion & Alignment: Unify user behavior, sales time series, and multimodal content into aligned high-dimensional representations.
2. Collaboration Between Recommendation LLMs and World Models: Leverage LLMs and world models to generate personalized recommendations end-to-end.
3. Item Tokenization for Recommendation: Encode hundreds of millions of items and massive user behavior data for large-scale training, optimizing via advanced architectures, post-training (e.g., RLVR), and efficient inference.
4. Multimodal Large Models for E-commerce: Build multilingual, multimodal models achieving SOTA performance and powering intelligent e-commerce agents.
5. Agent Evaluation, Safety & Compliance: Establish robust metrics and safeguards to ensure performance, safety, and compliance in real-world scenarios.

- Technical Value - Build a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, leveraging iterative improvements in models, data, and compute to achieve scaling-law-driven growth and establish a strong technical foundation.
- Business Value - Establish a foundational large model for Global E-commerce, leveraging generative recommendation, temporal models, and agent-based systems to drive GMV growth and user retention, forming a high-leverage revenue engine.

- Computer Vision & Multimodality:
In-depth research experience in multimedia or computer vision fields, including but not limited to image search, image/video classification and recognition, image segmentation, object detection, OCR, graph neural networks, multimodal learning, and unsupervised/self-supervised learning.
